name: spring-ai-chat
title: Spring AI Chat
description: Perform chat operations using Spring AI.
label: ai

properties.name: chatId
properties.description: The ID of the chat endpoint

properties.name: chatClient
properties.description: The ChatClient instance to use for chat operations. ChatClient provides advanced features like memory management and advisors. If not provided, a ChatClient will be created from the ChatModel.

properties.name: chatModel
properties.description: The ChatModel instance to use for chat operations. This is used to create a ChatClient if one is not explicitly provided.

properties.name: chatOperation
properties.description: The chat operation to perform.

properties.name: systemMessage
properties.description: Default system message to set context for the conversation. Can be overridden by the CamelSpringAiChatSystemMessage header.

properties.name: tags
properties.description: Tags for discovering and calling Camel route tools

properties.name: toolNames
properties.description: Comma-separated tool names for selecting tools by name. Names are resolved against a ToolCallbackResolver bound in the registry (Spring Boot applications get Spring AI's auto-configured one), then against the tools discovered via tags and configured via toolCallbacks, and finally against a ToolCallback bound in the registry under that name. An unresolvable name fails the exchange.

properties.name: userMessage
properties.description: Default user message text for multimodal requests. Can be combined with media data in the message body.

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: advisors
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: List of custom advisors to add to the ChatClient. These advisors will be added after the built-in advisors (SimpleLogger, SafeGuard, ChatMemory, QuestionAnswer) in the order they are provided in the list.

properties.name: chatMemory
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: ChatMemory instance for maintaining conversation history across requests. When provided, conversation context will be automatically managed using MessageChatMemoryAdvisor.

properties.name: chatMemoryVectorStore
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: VectorStore instance for maintaining conversation history using semantic search. When provided, conversation context will be automatically managed using VectorStoreChatMemoryAdvisor. This is an alternative to chatMemory that uses vector embeddings for long-term memory with semantic retrieval.

properties.name: entityClass
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: The Java class to use for entity response conversion using ChatClient.entity(Class). When specified, the response will be automatically converted to this type instead of returning a String.

properties.name: maxFileSize
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: Maximum file size in bytes for multimodal content (images, audio, PDFs, etc.). Files exceeding this size will be rejected with an exception. Default is 1048576 bytes (1MB). Set to 0 to disable size checking (not recommended).

properties.name: maxTokens
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: Maximum tokens in the response.

properties.name: mcpServer
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: MCP server configurations. Define servers using prefix notation: mcpServer..transportType=stdiosse, mcpServer..command= (stdio), mcpServer..args= (stdio), mcpServer..url= (sse), mcpServer..oauthProfile= (OAuth profile for HTTP auth, requires camel-oauth). This is a multi-value option with prefix: mcpServer.

properties.name: mcpTimeout
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: Timeout in seconds for MCP operations including tool execution and initialization

properties.name: outputClass
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: The Java class to use for BEAN output format conversion. Required when outputFormat is BEAN.

properties.name: outputFormat
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: The output format for structured output conversion (BEAN, MAP, LIST). Used in conjunction with outputClass for BEAN format.

properties.name: structuredOutputConverter
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: A StructuredOutputConverter for converting the chat response to structured output (e.g., BeanOutputConverter, MapOutputConverter, ListOutputConverter). When provided, the converter will be used to transform the response into the desired format.

properties.name: structuredOutputValidation
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: Enable structured output validation with automatic retry on validation failure. When enabled, the StructuredOutputValidationAdvisor validates the response against a JSON Schema and re-prompts the LLM with validation errors if the output is invalid.

properties.name: structuredOutputValidationMaxAttempts
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for structured output validation

properties.name: systemMetadata
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: Metadata to attach to system messages. This metadata can be used for tracking system prompt versions, model configurations, or other application-specific data.

properties.name: temperature
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: Temperature parameter for response randomness (0.0-2.0).

properties.name: toolCallbacks
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: List of ToolCallback instances to register alongside Camel route tools. Use MethodToolCallbackProvider.builder().toolObjects(bean).build().getToolCallbacks() to resolve callbacks from Tool-annotated beans.

properties.name: toolContext
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: Context map to pass to tools during execution. Tool methods accepting a ToolContext parameter will receive these values.

properties.name: topKSampling
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: Top K parameter for sampling.

properties.name: topP
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: Top P parameter for nucleus sampling.

properties.name: userMetadata
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: Metadata to attach to user messages. This metadata can be used for tracking conversation context, message identifiers, or other application-specific data.

properties.name: ragTemplate
properties.label: rag

properties.name: similarityThreshold
properties.label: rag
properties.description: Similarity threshold for RAG retrieval (default: 0.7).

properties.name: topK
properties.label: rag
properties.description: Number of top documents to retrieve for RAG (default: 5).

properties.name: vectorStore
properties.label: rag
properties.description: VectorStore for automatic RAG retrieval.

properties.name: safeguardFailureResponse
properties.label: security
properties.description: Failure response message for SafeGuard advisor when sensitive content is detected. If not specified, a default message will be used.

properties.name: safeguardSensitiveWords
properties.label: security
properties.description: Comma-separated list of sensitive words for SafeGuard advisor. When provided, the SafeGuard advisor will be enabled to prevent generation of content containing these words.

properties.name: safeguardOrder
properties.label: security,advanced
properties.description: Order of execution for SafeGuard advisor. Lower numbers execute first. Default is 0.
